title: Questions and answers
summary: Five common questions, answered only from Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A.'s dars. Where the dars gives no answer, the question is for your teacher.

blocks.p: Hazrat answers with the book: even arithmetic is learned from a teacher, and a person cannot see his own mistakes, so on the path of Allah a spiritual teacher is needed. Is it necessary for everyone? For whoever wants to keep the rules of the path at a high level; 'if you do not consider it necessary, you are deprived'.

blocks.q: Whoever has no pir, his pir is Shaytan. The murid has his master's hand over him, so Shaytan cannot touch him.

blocks.h: I slipped after taking bai'at. What now?

blocks.p: Repent and recite the istighfar. Even a sinless person who repents gains by it; repentance never goes to waste. Hazrat also tells of a Companion whom the Prophet ﷺ asked to give bai'at again, and says: 'Once you have given bai'at, renew it.'

blocks.q: Even if a sinless person repents, it is good for him. Repentance never goes to waste.

blocks.p: Hazrat says Qadri, Chishti, Naqshbandi and the others all draw from the Qur'an and Hadith, as the four schools of fiqh do. Temperaments differ, and each person finds what suits him. All the murshids have one goal: to keep the murid pure and on the way of the Prophet ﷺ.

blocks.q: All the Sufi ways are good, good from head to toe.

blocks.p: No. Hazrat says khilafat comes from above. A murid may ask himself whether he is worthy, but he should not ask for it; he should stay silent. Allah gives what He wills.

blocks.q: Neither a merely formal discipleship is of any use, nor a merely formal khilafat.

blocks.h: Can I start tasawwur or the zikr practices on my own?

blocks.p: The dars does not give a general rule. In every case Hazrat describes, the practice came from the shaykh: his own pir taught him tasawwur, and he speaks of giving permission for Hizbul Bahr. This question is for your teacher.

blocks.note: Have a question that is not here? Ask your shaykh or khalifa. These answers are drafts from the transcripts and await a teacher's approval.

ru.title: Sawaal aur jawaab
ru.summary: Paanch aam sawaal, jinke jawaab sirf Hazrat Azam Pasha R.A. ke dars se diye gaye hain. Jahaan dars mein jawaab nahin, woh sawaal apne ustaad se poochiye.

blocks.h: Kya mujhe shaykh ki zaroorat hai?

blocks.p: Hazrat kitaab se jawaab dete hain: hisaab bhi ustaad se seekha jaata hai, aur aadmi apni ghaltiyaan khud nahin dekh sakta, isliye Allah ke raaste mein ek roohani ustaad ki zaroorat hai. Kya yeh har ek ke liye zaroori hai? Us ke liye jo is raaste ke qaaidon ko ooncha darje par nibhaana chahta hai; 'agar tum isko zaroori nahin samajhte to tum mahroom ho'.

blocks.q: Jiska koi pir nahin, uska pir Shaitaan hai. Murid ke upar uske aaqa ka haath hota hai, isliye Shaitaan usko chhoo nahin sakta.

blocks.h: Bai'at ke baad mujh se ghalti ho gayi. Ab kya karoon?

blocks.p: Tauba kijiye aur istighfar padhiye. Begunaah aadmi bhi tauba kare to usko faayda hai; tauba kabhi zaaya nahin jaati. Hazrat ek Sahabi ka waaqia bhi sunaate hain jinse Huzoor ﷺ ne dobara bai'at karne ko kaha, aur farmate hain: 'Ek baar bai'at kar li to uski tajdeed karo.'

blocks.q: Begunaah aadmi bhi tauba kare to uske liye achha hai. Tauba kabhi zaaya nahin jaati.

blocks.h: Kaunsa silsila sab se behtar hai?

blocks.p: Hazrat farmate hain ke Qadri, Chishti, Naqshbandi aur baaqi sab Qur'an aur Hadith se hi lete hain, jaise fiqh ke chaar mazhab. Mizaaj alag alag hote hain, aur har ek ko woh milta hai jo uske mizaaj ke mutaabiq ho. Sab murshidon ka ek hi maqsad hai: murid ko paak rakhna aur Huzoor ﷺ ke raaste par rakhna.

blocks.q: Sufiya ke saare tareeqe achhe hain, sar se paaon tak achhe.

blocks.h: Kya main khilafat maang sakta hoon?

blocks.p: Nahin. Hazrat farmate hain ke khilafat upar se aati hai. Murid apne aap se pooch sakta hai ke kya main laayeq hoon, lekin usko maangna nahin chahiye; khaamosh rehna chahiye. Allah jo chahta hai deta hai.

blocks.q: Na sirf rasmi mureedi kisi kaam ki hai, na sirf rasmi khilafat.

blocks.h: Kya main tasawwur ya zikr ke amal khud se shuru kar sakta hoon?

blocks.p: Dars mein iska koi aam qaa'ida nahin diya gaya. Hazrat jitne bhi waaqiaat sunaate hain, har ek mein amal shaykh se aaya: unke apne pir ne unko tasawwur sikhaaya, aur woh Hizbul Bahr ki ijaazat dene ki baat karte hain. Yeh sawaal apne ustaad se poochiye.

blocks.note: Aapka sawaal yahaan nahin hai? Apne shaykh ya khalifa se poochiye. Yeh jawaab transcripts se tayyar kiye gaye draft hain aur ustaad ki manzoori ke intezaar mein hain.
